rawRequest: Create a cinematic 18-second launch film and an interactive website for an original floating observatory. Start in a storm, reveal its living archive, and end on an invitation to explore. Make it feel physically grounded and emotionally hopeful.
assumptions: Demonstration concept, not an approved MGR brand or franchise
Website implementation will follow this specification
No reference media are uploaded in this text-only demonstration
requirements: The observatory has three asymmetric copper rings
Warm interior light contrasts with blue storm light
Preserve left-to-right travel across the first cut
End on a still frame with space for separately typeset copy
Do not generate readable logos or UI text inside video

context.world: An original airborne research observatory above a storm sea
context.hero: Adult archivist in a charcoal waterproof coat with a single amber cuff light
context.palette: Desaturated blue exterior, warm amber interior, oxidized copper structures
context.continuity: Wet surfaces, three copper rings, same coat and cuff light across shots
context.delivery: 18-second 16:9 sequence; editorial handles and final frame-rate choice require later production review

locks.value: Adult archivist in a charcoal waterproof coat with a single amber cuff light

nodes.purpose: Establish scale and danger while making the observatory recognizable
nodes.subject: Three asymmetric copper rings suspended above a dark storm sea
nodes.action: Clouds part to expose a warm doorway; a small archivist crosses toward it left to right
nodes.camera: Wide establishing view with restrained forward movement; maintain horizon and direction of travel
nodes.lighting: Broad cold sky light, warm doorway practical, coherent wet reflections
nodes.sound: Low wind and distant thunder; a faint rising tonal motif
nodes.startState: Observatory partially hidden; archivist at the left edge of the bridge
nodes.endState: Doorway occupies right third; archivist reaches the threshold

beats.action: Rings and bridge reveal; archivist walks right
Hold on the threshold for the cut

acceptance: No body or bridge geometry discontinuity

nodes.purpose: Turn danger into discovery through one clear physical interaction
nodes.subject: The same archivist beside a translucent archive table
nodes.action: The archivist enters left to right, pauses, then opens a palm above the table as a luminous map rises
nodes.camera: Medium side view with one slow push; hand and table remain readable
nodes.lighting: Amber practical above the table, cool storm rim through doorway; map light grows gently
nodes.sound: Wind becomes muffled indoors; quiet cloth movement and one crystalline activation tone
nodes.startState: Archivist enters frame from left wearing the same wet charcoal coat
nodes.endState: Open palm rests still above a fully formed map; amber cuff stays on the same wrist

beats.action: Lift palm; table begins to glow

acceptance: Same coat and cuff as first shot
Map has a stable base on the table
No abrupt lighting or camera jump

nodes.purpose: Resolve the reveal into an invitation
nodes.subject: The luminous map and the observatory window beyond it
nodes.action: Storm light softens as the map rotates slightly; all motion settles into the final composition
nodes.camera: Close view opening gently to a balanced tableau; reserve left third for separately rendered title
nodes.lighting: Maintain amber map light and cool window direction; gradual lift in exposure without clipping
nodes.sound: Resolve tonal motif; leave a clean tail for the edit
nodes.startState: Map position matches the previous end frame
nodes.endState: Two-second stable tableau with legible negative space and no generated text

site.goal: Let visitors explore the observatory story and request an exhibition invitation
site.audience: Visitors interested in immersive science exhibits
site.visualDirection: Editorial copper and storm-blue layout, large legible type, restrained motion, real HTML text
site.mobile: Single-column hierarchy, touch controls, static poster until playback is requested; no hover-only content
site.performanceBudget: Provisional target: LCP <= 2.5s and CLS <= 0.1 on an agreed mobile lab profile; establish baseline before accepting

routes.purpose: Invitation request with clear success and failure states

controls.label: Play film
controls.action: Start native video playback with captions and pause controls

controls.label: Request invitation
controls.action: Submit validated contact form to configured service; show pending, error and confirmed outcomes; never fake success

motion.effect: Play launch film once with pause available
motion.reducedMotion: Show static poster and an explicit Play button
Show content immediately with no transform

acceptance: Every link and form control works
All motion has a purpose and accessible alternative
Actual browser performance measured; no metric inferred from source code
